verdict.rationale: Bento ships a documented MCP server plus 'Skills' guidance that lets an AI assistant look up subscribers, create broadcasts, track events, and manage the account entirely through natural conversation, alongside CLI/SDK surfaces the agent can choose from. This directly matches the ai-native/natural-language operation story with first-party docs describing setup and safety guidance. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification that natural-language commands work reliably in practice beyond vendor docs.
